title: Santoshi Maa
desc: Sindoori overhears Kaki and Santoshi's conversation about deceiving Dhairya and promptly rushes to him to disclose the truth. However, before she can reach him, Ankur kidnaps her.

title: Jodha Akbar
desc: During the 16th century, Emperor Akbar secures a crucial alliance through his marriage to Jodha, a princess from the esteemed Rajput dynasty.

title: Kundali Bhagya
desc: Despite Akshay's anger, Kritika plays fairly, causing Preeta's team to win. Afterwards, Deepak overhears Preeta and Srishti's conversation, uncovering their home location.

title: Vasudha
desc: Hanumant expresses his regrets to Chandrika and departs the mansion alongside Vasudha and Raghu. Later, Devansh encounters Hanumant's family and expresses his regrets to Vasudha.

title: Saru
desc: Ved discovers that the man with whom Saru's marriage has been arranged is already married. Later, Ved informs Sitaram of this ordeal, who persuades Saru to move to Mumbai and focus on her studies.

title: Hamari Radha
desc: Girdhar leaves a sick Kian behind to offer comfort to Shanaya. Meanwhile, Radha panics at home as Kian's fever continues to rise.

title: Bhagya Lakshmi
desc: Rano successfully convinces Lakshmi to avoid calling off the upcoming nuptials. Later, Rishi inadvertently drops a precious ancestral necklace that falls perfectly onto Lakshmi's neck.

title: Jaane Anjaane Hum Mile
desc: Reet rushes to the hospital upon learning of Unnati's suicide attempt. Later, she makes a decision and visits Raghav's house with Shagun.

title: Vasudha
desc: Chandrika restores Hanumant's job but enforces strict boundaries to limit Vasudha. While they adjust, Sarika senses hidden danger upon hearing Gulki barking.

title: Saru
desc: Saru is sent to Mumbai by Sitaram, but Gouri attempts to intervene. Suddenly, Sitaram's health declines rapidly, and with his last breath, he secures a promise from Gouri.
